description: memory://<bundle-id>/<slug> is resolved locally, and only for this Bundle's own bundle.id: the alias is accepted wherever a slug argument is accepted and normalized to the slug before any other rule runs. It is never dereferenced over the network and never emitted as an RDF subject (AGSC-05-04). A foreign bundle-id is refused with AGSC-E309 because a node has no registry of other nodes' ids — use the https:// IRI (AGSC-05-04a).
